headline: A slow, coastal rhythm through Goa

days_plan.title: North Goa light
days_plan.theme: Beaches and an easy first evening

items.name: Calangute Beach
items.description: Start on a wide shoreline with room to walk, swim, and settle into Goa's pace without a packed schedule.

items.name: Souza Lobo
items.description: A long-running beachfront kitchen. Vegetarian thalis and Goan vegetable curries sit comfortably next to seafood plates.

items.name: Fort Aguada
items.description: A 17th-century Portuguese fort above the Arabian Sea. Short walks, lighthouse views, and a clear sense of Goa's layered history.

items.name: Baga sunset stroll
items.description: An unhurried walk along the water as the light drops. Optional snack stop at a shack if you want to linger.

days_plan.title: Old Goa and Panjim
days_plan.theme: Churches, painted lanes, and a riverside evening

items.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
items.description: A UNESCO baroque church that holds the relics of St. Francis Xavier. Quiet interiors, carved wood, and a slower morning.

items.name: Se Cathedral
items.description: One of Asia's largest churches, a short walk from the Basilica. Golden altars and a vast nave that rewards unhurried looking.

items.name: Fontainhas walking circuit
items.description: Latin Quarter lanes in ochre, indigo, and terracotta. Small galleries, tiled houses, and bakeries between the slopes.

items.name: Viva Panjim
items.description: Goan home cooking in a heritage house. Strong vegetarian plates, coconut gravies, and a calm courtyard table.

items.name: Mandovi riverside evening
items.description: A dusk cruise on the Mandovi with city lights coming on. Optional if you prefer to keep the evening on land.

days_plan.title: South Goa hush
days_plan.theme: Quieter water, a spice garden, and a last meal

items.name: Palolem Beach
items.description: A crescent bay that feels slower than the north. Swim, read, or walk the curve of coconut shade.

items.name: Sahakari Spice Farm
items.description: A guided walk through pepper, nutmeg, and cocoa. Includes a simple vegetarian plantation lunch on most visits.

items.name: Anjuna flea & boutiques
items.description: Textiles, ceramics, and small-batch crafts. Easy to skip if you would rather stay by the water.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: South Indian flavours in a garden setting. Excellent vegetable curries and a last-night table that does not rush you.

extras.name: Morjim Beach
extras.description: A quieter stretch known for open sky and a slower shoreline. Swap this in when you want more sea and less crowd.

extras.name: Reis Magos Fort
extras.description: A restored riverside fort with galleries and estuary views. A calmer cultural stop than the busier north beaches.

extras.name: Café Bodega
extras.description: Light plates, salads, and a vegetarian-friendly cafe menu if you want another unhurried meal in the city.

extras.name: Beach yoga hour
extras.description: A short morning session on the sand. Built for a relaxed itinerary that wants space rather than another sightseeing stop.

extras.name: Dudhsagar viewpoint trail
extras.description: A longer, costlier day trip to the waterfall belt. Easy to drop if you ask SETUVIA to remove expensive activities.
